levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» takes prev1's names up to يونس; prev1 goes on to حماد and عبد الأعلى, which this text does not take over, since its next name is سعدان
the text names يونس again right after «بهذا الإسناد»: one man in succession is one link (rule 7), so he is written once, in prev1's fuller form
«يرفعه إلى» is a gap after سعدان (rule 8); the Imam after it is written inside the chain, so he stays a narrator
